title: bug: size_t->word32 silent truncation in soft_sign and soft_decrypt
description: soft_sign() and soft_decrypt() in wp11_backend_soft.c cast size_t inlen/ctlen to word32 before passing to wc_RsaSSL_Sign() and wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt(). On 64-bit systems, if inlen > UINT32_MAX the upper bits are silently discarded: the wolfCrypt call operates on a different (much shorter) length than intended, potentially reading uninitialized memory or signing the wrong digest. Fix: add if (inlen > (size_t)UINT32_MAX) return -1 in both RSA branches before the cast.
